cover.title:
3 countries, 13 relaxed days:
Sri Lanka → Thailand → Malaysia
cover.sub: The cheapest comfortable route we found for a Pakistani passport within 5 lakh, with every visa, document and booking step in the right order. Written for a gold business owner who has personal and business bank accounts and gold statements.

stats.l: expected total from Karachi (Lahore: see the rule below)
one SriLankan Airlines booking, 30 kg bag

blocks.title: Why this route
items: **Cheapest visas:** Sri Lanka's ETA is free for Pakistanis; Thailand and Malaysia are online (the Thai fee is paid in cash at the embassy).
**One airline ticket** out and home, which satisfies FIA's same-airline return-ticket rule.
**Halal food is easy** in all three countries, with mosques everywhere.
**No rushing:** 2–4 nights in each place, 4 flights in 13 days, no overnight buses.

blocks.title: The one rule that keeps you inside 5 lakh
blocks.text: Everything except the SriLankan ticket costs ≈ **PKR 2.93 lakh** (AirAsia included). **Price that ticket first** (section 8). **PKR 1.8 lakh or less** → this 3-country plan. **More** → the 2-country plan (Sri Lanka + Malaysia, 13 nights, ≈ PKR 4.5–4.6 lakh). Lahore fares are usually higher, so from Lahore expect the 2-country plan. A 4th country does not fit.

cover.foot: Researched and fact-checked on 6 November 2026 against government visa portals, embassy pages, airline fare pages, flight schedules and 2026 news. Prices are estimates at **PKR 280 = USD 1**. Visa rules and flight times change, so re-check each official link the week you apply.

tocBlocks.title: How to use this plan
items: **1.** Read sections 1 and 2, then get a SriLankan Airlines price for your dates. The rule in section 2 tells you whether to do 3 countries or 2.
**2.** Follow the timeline in section 3 **in order**. Each step points to the section with the details.
**3.** Tick the checklists as you go. Print sections 4, 10 and 11 and keep them in your hand luggage.

tocBlocks.text: **Short words used here:** ETA = Sri Lanka's online visa · e-Visa / eVISA = Thailand's / Malaysia's online visa · TDAC / MDAC = free online arrival cards for Thailand / Malaysia · FIA = Pakistan airport immigration · ATL = FBR's Active Taxpayer List (being a 'filer') · NIMS = NADRA's vaccination record, which gives the polio certificate · SAARC = South Asian countries incl. Pakistan (cheaper tickets in Sri Lanka) · DMK = Bangkok's Don Mueang airport · KLIA = Kuala Lumpur airport (Terminal 1; KLIA2 = Terminal 2) · OTP = the one-time code your bank sends by SMS.
Official websites you will use (bookmark these; avoid look-alike sites)

cols.text: Best dates

rows: After Eid ul-Fitr (≈ 10 Mar) and before the 13–15 April New Year holidays in Sri Lanka and Thailand. Dry in Sri Lanka, hot in Bangkok and KL. Hotels are cheaper than in January, and you have time to prepare calmly. **Example dates in this plan: Tue 23 Mar → Sun 4 Apr 2027.**
Best weather, but peak hotel prices, Thaipusam crowds in KL (Fri 22 Jan) and pre-Chinese-New-Year prices. Only possible if you pay the Thai visa fee by about **20 November 2026**.
Ramadan (≈ 8 Feb – 9 Mar 2027), Eid weeks, 13–15 April, and May–September (monsoon in Sri Lanka, rain in Bangkok).

cols.text: Spending style this budget assumes

items: A **private room with AC and its own bathroom** in a guesthouse or 2-star hotel (USD 20–30 a night). No dormitories.
Mostly **local halal restaurants** (USD 9–13 a day).
Buses, Grab and PickMe, plus **two private car trips** in Sri Lanka (Negombo → Kandy, and the Sigiriya/Dambulla day).
Entry tickets for every sight in the itinerary.
Not included: shopping, gifts and gold.

cols.text: SriLankan Airlines doesn't fly from Islamabad. Take the motorway bus to Lahore (≈ 4–5 h, ≈ PKR 3,000) and use the Lahore column.

cols.title: Decision rule (do this before anything else)
items: Everything except the SriLankan ticket ≈ **PKR 2.93 lakh** (Karachi) or **2.97 lakh** (Lahore), AirAsia included.
**Ticket ≤ PKR 1.8 lakh** → do this 3-country plan (at least ≈ PKR 20,000 left over).
**Ticket above 1.8 lakh** → do the 2-country plan: **Sri Lanka + Malaysia, 13 nights**, ≈ **PKR 4.5–4.6 lakh**, no Thai visa needed (section 12).

**From Lahore** the typical fare (≈ 2.05 lakh) is above the line: the 3-country total is ≈ 5.02 lakh, just over budget. Take the 2-country plan, or start from Karachi, or use the 'Lahore lite' savings (≈ 4.83 lakh, very little spare).

cols.text: Savings, if you need them

rows: Bus from Negombo to Kandy via Colombo instead of a private car (a longer day)
Skip the Bangkok early check-in night (leave your bag at the hotel, check in at 2 pm)
Public bus to Sigiriya/Dambulla instead of the car day
Pay hotels in local cash at check-in where allowed (avoids the card's 4% FX fee); then carry USD 1,000, not 900. Malaysia must be prepaid.
Skip the Petronas Skybridge (the towers are free to see from KLCC Park). It is not in the budget anyway.

blocks.title: Also keep in mind
items: **Show money is not spending money.** Thailand can ask to see **20,000 baht (≈ USD 600)** when you arrive, and Malaysia turns back travellers with too little money. Carry about **USD 900 in cash**. Keep USD 650 untouched until Bangkok immigration, and at least USD 300 until KL immigration (section 9).
**A visa refusal costs real money** (section 12): a Thai refusal loses ≈ PKR 40,000–70,000 on top of the plan. That is why the cushion matters.
**Your bank balance must be much larger than the trip** (section 4).

blocks.text: Step-by-step timeline: what to do, and when
blocks.sub: Weeks are counted back from departure; the example dates are for a Tue 23 March 2027 departure. Do the visas in this order: Thailand first (slowest and strictest), then Malaysia, then Sri Lanka.

items.title: Get a first airline price and decide: 3 countries or 2
items.text: Price your dates on srilankan.com/en-pk (section 8) and apply the rule in section 2. Then you know which plan you are preparing for. You buy the ticket later (step 6).

items.title: Check your passport
items.text: It must be valid at least **6 months after you come home** (until at least October 2027) with **3+ blank pages** (Malaysia's rule). If not, renew now: e-passport 36 pages, 5 years = Rs 9,000 (21 working days) or Rs 15,000 urgent (5 working days), paid cashless through Passport Fee Asaan. Keep old passports; they show your travel history.

items.title: Fix your tax and bank profile
items: Check you are on FBR's **Active Taxpayer List** at iris.fbr.gov.pk (Verifications). Filers pay half the card tax and look much stronger to visa officers.
Keep a **steady personal balance** and avoid big one-off deposits; move money from the business account as regular monthly drawings (section 4).

Bank papers (stamped and signed): a **12-month personal statement**, a **business statement** and an **account maintenance certificate** for each. Collect them about a week before the Thai application (≈ mid-Jan), a fresh 3-month statement for Malaysia (≈ mid-Feb), and a fresh set a week before you fly, for FIA.

items.title: Collect your business documents
items.text: NTN certificate, last 2 years of FBR returns with wealth statement, chamber or sarafa/jewellers' association certificate, shop rent agreement or ownership papers, and (optional) a gold valuation certificate. Get English translations of anything in Urdu. Full list in section 4.

items.title: Polio drops + NIMS certificate
items.when: T−10 to T−5 weeks · Jan–mid Feb
items.text: Get the free oral polio dose at a government hospital, EPI centre or District Health Office (bring CNIC and passport). Then download the certificate at **nims.nadra.gov.pk** (≈ Rs 100). The dose must be **4 weeks to 12 months** before you fly. Don't rely on the airport counter.

items.title: Buy the SriLankan ticket
items: Re-price it and apply the rule in section 2: the 3-country route (section 8) or the Plan B route (section 12).

**Before paying, phone the call centre (+94 11 777 1979): does this fare allow date and route changes, and what does a change cost?** Write the answer down. Choose a fare that is **non-refundable but changeable**: Thailand asks for a non-refundable ticket, and Plans B and C need changes.
Check each flight's **time**. Book hotels to match (section 8).

items.title: Book AirAsia Bangkok → KL and all hotels
items.text: Buy AirAsia with a 20 kg bag. Book every night: Sri Lanka and Bangkok with free cancellation. **Kuala Lumpur must be prepaid** (Malaysia asks for proof of PAID accommodation); choose a 'pay now' rate that is still free to cancel. Use only real bookings; fake or 'held' bookings mean refusal. **After the visas are issued, don't cancel or change these bookings** (cancelled bookings are a red flag).

items.title: Apply for the Thailand e-Visa and pay the fee
items.text: Apply on thaievisa.go.th, then pay PKR 13,000 in cash the next working morning (Islamabad: embassy Visa Gate; Karachi: as the consulate tells you; section 5). Stay in Pakistan until it is approved, about 14 working days after the fee is received (≈ 16 Feb). **Print it.**

items.title: Apply for the Malaysia eVISA
items.text: On malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my (section 6), about 6 weeks before you reach KL and before Malaysia's Eid holidays (≈ 10–11 Mar). It takes 2–7 working days and can be used for 6 months. Check your email daily: if they ask for more documents, reply within 5 days. Print the eVISA Note.

items.title: Apply for the free Sri Lanka ETA
items.text: On eta.gov.lk, 2–4 weeks before you fly (section 7). The fee should show **zero**. Print the approval.

items.title: Insurance, money, phone
items.text: Buy EFU (or similar) insurance in Pakistan before the trip starts. Buy about USD 900 from a licensed exchange company (keep the receipt). Switch on international use for your debit card and **international roaming for your Pakistani SIM** (for bank OTPs). Pack (section 9).

items.title: Optional: visit the FIA facilitation desk
items.text: FIA zonal offices in Lahore and Karachi run pre-departure facilitation desks (9 am–5 pm, every day). They check visas, return ticket and cash limits. Re-check any new FIA rules.

items.title: Print everything and fill in your trip card
items.text: Two printed copies of every visa, ticket and hotel booking, plus PDFs on your phone. The Thai e-Visa **must be on paper**. Fill in the trip card in section 11.

items.title: Fly
items.text: Be at the airport **4 hours early**. Declare your USD cash (Pass Track app or the Customs desk) and anything you wear of value, and keep the copies for your return (sections 9 and 10).

items.title: Two online arrival cards during the trip
items: **Thailand TDAC**, free, within 72 hours before landing in Bangkok: tdac.immigration.go.th. Do it on Day 4 or 5.
**Malaysia MDAC**, free, within 3 days before landing in KL (submission day counts): imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main. Do it on Day 8, 9 or 10.

blocks.sub: Prepare one file and use it for all three visas and for FIA at the airport. Get bank papers stamped and signed, and dated within about 2 weeks of each application.

cols.title: Money and tax
items: **Personal bank statement, last 12 months** (Thailand asks for at least 1 year; Malaysia for 3 months)
**Account maintenance certificate** from the bank (name, CNIC, account number, opening date, current and average balance)
**Business bank statement, 6–12 months** + its maintenance certificate
**NTN certificate** (print from FBR IRIS)
**FBR income tax returns + wealth statement**, last 2 years, with IRIS acknowledgement
**ATL printout** (Active Taxpayer List status)

cols.title: Business and ties to Pakistan
items: Business registration: NTN in the business name, STRN if any, partnership deed or SECP papers
**Chamber of commerce** and/or **sarafa / jewellers' association** membership certificate
Shop rent agreement or ownership papers (translated into English if in Urdu)
**Letter on your business letterhead** (signed, stamped): you are the owner since [year]; the business runs normally under [manager] while you travel; your travel dates; the date you resume work
Business cards
Optional: **Family Registration Certificate** (NADRA) to show family ties

cols.title: Identity and travel
items: Passport (6+ months valid after return, 3+ blank pages) + old passports
2 copies of CNIC; 2 copies of passport bio page and any previous visas
Photos: **35 × 50 mm, white background, studio, taken within 6 months, no cap** (Malaysia's rule; also fine for Thailand). Keep a digital file under 2 MB.

**Proof of address** where you live now (utility bill or rent agreement). Thailand requires it. If the bill is in your father's name, a common way to show the link is to add his CNIC and your Family Registration Certificate.
SriLankan e-ticket, AirAsia ticket, hotel bookings, insurance, NIMS polio certificate
**Cover letter** (template in section 13)

cols.title: How to use your gold statements
items: Embassies judge **money in the bank**, not gold. No official checklist accepts gold in place of a bank statement. Gold shows you are wealthy and have reasons to come back; it is **supporting evidence only**.
The strongest proof is your **FBR wealth statement** showing the gold, year after year.
Optional: an **independent valuation certificate** (bank-approved appraiser or your jewellers' association, not your own shop), with weight, karat, rate, value, valuer's name, stamp and date.

**Only submit a valuation for gold that is in your wealth statement, at a similar value.** A valuation far above your tax returns is itself a red flag. If unsure, ask your tax adviser, or leave it out.

cols.text: How much should be in the account?

rows: No minimum on the embassy checklist, but the e-Visa portal's 'more documents' screen mentions at least 30,000 baht (≈ PKR 2.5 lakh). Multiple entry needs > PKR 6.5 lakh for 6 months. Media and agents quote PKR 3.5–5 lakh.
No minimum; carry proof of funds.

Keep **PKR 7.5–10 lakh** steady in your **personal** account for 6+ months, about 1.5–2 times the trip cost, so the trip money leaves a healthy balance behind. (Practical guidance, not an official rule.)

cols.title: Red flags that get visas refused
items: A **big deposit just before applying** (e.g. after selling gold). If unavoidable, keep the sale invoice and make sure it matches your tax return.
Balance far bigger than the income on your tax return, or a large business turnover with an empty personal account
Not on the ATL / no tax returns
Business name or address different on the NTN, bank account and chamber certificate
Fake, 'dummy' or cancelled bookings. Thailand warns this means rejection and possible **blacklisting**.

blocks.sub: Do this first: it is the slowest, the strictest, and you must be in Pakistan for the whole process.

blocks.name: Thailand: Tourist Visa (TR), single entry
facts: PKR 13,000 (Nov 2026), cash, non-refundable; pay what the portal shows
≈ 14 working days after the fee is received
Up to 60 days; enter within 3 months of issue
Where you live now, shown by your address proof. In practice: Islamabad embassy for Punjab, KP, ICT, AJK, GB; Karachi consulate for Sindh, Balochistan. Unsure? Email thaievisa@mfa.go.th
Printed e-Visa + TDAC + 20,000 baht or equivalent

steps.title: Book first, apply second.
steps.text: The embassy's checklist asks for a **confirmed, non-refundable air ticket** and accommodation. Upload your SriLankan e-ticket, the AirAsia Bangkok → KL ticket and your Bangkok hotel booking.

steps.title: Create an account on thaievisa.go.th
steps.text: Choose your mission (above), then **Tourist Visa (TR), single entry**.

steps.title: Fill the form and upload (JPG/PDF, max 3 MB each)
steps.text: Passport bio page; photo (within 6 months, matching how you look now); **proof of your current address in Pakistan**; tickets; hotel; 12-month bank statement + bank certificate; business letterhead letter; business registration papers (NTN, chamber/association); 2 CNIC copies; previous visas; cover letter. Wealth statement (and valuation, if used) as supporting documents.

steps.title: Print the application confirmation and pay in cash
steps.text: **Islamabad:** at the embassy **Visa Gate**, Monday–Friday mornings (about 09:30–13:00), in person or through a trusted relative. **Karachi:** the consulate doesn't publish its payment steps in English, so before you apply, phone or email the Royal Thai Consulate-General Karachi (contacts on karachi.thaiembassy.org) and ask where and when to pay. **Do not pay fixers**; the embassy warns against them.

steps.title: Wait in Pakistan (≈ 14 working days)
steps.text: You must stay in Pakistan until the decision. Embassy holidays add days. Check your email (and spam folder) daily.

steps.title: Print the e-Visa (2–3 copies)
steps.text: Phone copies are NOT accepted at check-in or at Thai immigration.

steps.title: Within 72 hours before landing in Bangkok
steps.text: Fill the free **Thailand Digital Arrival Card** at https://tdac.immigration.go.th (avoid look-alike sites that charge).

docs: Onward AirAsia ticket and SriLankan ticket home
**20,000 baht (≈ USD 600) in cash or equivalent**, which officers may ask to see
Say: 'Tourism, 4 nights at [hotel], then Kuala Lumpur on [date].'
blocks.warn: If Thailand refuses, you lose the PKR 13,000 fee and the trip to pay it, usually the AirAsia fare too, and you pay SriLankan's change fee: about PKR 40,000–70,000 in total. See section 12. Also: Thailand plans a 450-baht entry fee and a 1,000-baht air departure tax; neither was in force in November 2026. If introduced, they will probably be added to air tickets.

blocks.sub: Apply right after the Thai approval, about 6 weeks before you reach KL.

blocks.name: Malaysia: eVISA, Social visit (VTR), single entry
facts: https://malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my (only), or the official MyVISA app
RM20 visa + RM105 processing + 0.8% card fee ≈ RM126 (≈ PKR 9,000)
2–7 working days (apply at least 14 days before)
Up to 30 days; one entry; use within 6 months of issue
eVISA Note + MDAC + paid hotel + return ticket

steps.title: Register on malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my
steps.text: Choose eVISA → Social → **Visa Without Reference (VTR)**, single entry. You can't apply from inside Malaysia, so do it from Pakistan.

steps.title: Check your photo with the official photo checker
steps.text: 35 × 50 mm, white background, studio photo taken in the last 6 months, no cap or headgear, no selfie or scan, max 2 MB.

steps.title: Upload
steps.text: Passport bio page; your **whole itinerary as one PDF** (SriLankan ticket + AirAsia ticket); **paid** KL hotel voucher; **last 3 months' bank statements** (personal + business in one PDF); a short cover letter (optional but useful).

steps.title: Check the total on the payment screen, then pay
steps.text: It should be about RM126. Some 2026 websites claim RM200; the official fee table still shows RM20 for Pakistan.

steps.title: Watch your email for 5 days
steps.text: If Immigration asks for more documents or an interview, reply **within 5 days**, or the application is rejected automatically and the fee is lost. Don't apply twice: a new approval cancels the old one.

steps.title: Download and print the eVISA Note
Within 3 days before arriving (counting today)
steps.text: Fill the free **Malaysia Digital Arrival Card** at https://imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main. Last port of embarkation: Bangkok.

docs: At least USD 300 in cash + a working card
Say: 'Tourism, 3 nights at [hotel], flying home on [date].'
blocks.warn: In 2025 Malaysia's border agency turned back Pakistani travellers at KLIA ('Not To Land') for fake hotel bookings, no return ticket or too little money. If refused entry, you are put on a flight back to where you came from (Bangkok) at your own cost. Your single-entry Thai visa is already used, so you may have to buy a ticket home from the airport. Have every paper ready.

blocks.sub: The easiest one. Do it last, 2–4 weeks before you fly.

blocks.name: Sri Lanka: Tourist ETA (free for Pakistan)
facts: 30 days, double entry within those 30 days
Within 3 months of the ETA being issued

steps.title: Check the free scheme is still on
steps.text: Press reports say it was approved for one year (to about May 2027), with a review around November 2026. A March 2027 trip is inside that, but if the site shows a fee for Pakistan, the scheme has changed.

steps.title: Open eta.gov.lk → Apply → Tourist ETA (individual)
steps.text: Look-alike agent sites charge USD 20–100 for this free ETA.

steps.title: Type your details exactly as in your passport
steps.text: Occupation: business owner (gold/jewellery). Purpose: tourism. Arrival: Colombo (BIA). Address: your Negombo hotel. Mistakes can't be corrected later; you'd have to apply again.

steps.title: The fee must show zero
steps.text: If you see a payment page, check you are really on eta.gov.lk.

steps.title: Save the reference number; print the approval email
steps.text: Track status on the site or the 24/7 helpline.

docs: SriLankan ticket showing your onward flight
Proof of funds (cash, card, bank statement)
Say: 'Tourism, 4 nights in Negombo, Kandy and Colombo, then Bangkok on [date].'
blocks.warn: Sri Lanka Customs: tell the Customs officer in the arrival hall about any gold jewellery you are wearing. Gold bars and biscuits are not allowed as passenger baggage. Foreign cash needs a declaration only above USD 15,000.

cols.text: The SriLankan Airlines ticket (one booking)

items.title: srilankan.com/en-pk → Book → Multi-city
items.text: Use the Pakistan site and pay in **PKR** (a foreign-currency payment adds ≈ 4% card fees). Enter 3 flights:
items: Lahore or Karachi → **Colombo** (Day 1)
Colombo → **Bangkok** (the ≈ 01:05 flight on the night of Day 5 → Day 6)
**Kuala Lumpur → Lahore or Karachi** (Day 13, as one flight; the site picks the Colombo connection)

items.title: Check the times before you pay
items.text: In the 2026 schedule: Lahore 18:25 → Colombo ≈ 22:20 (Karachi lands ≈ 21:30); Colombo → Bangkok ≈ 01:05, landing ≈ 06:15; KL → Colombo mid-morning (≈ 08:00–09:45) or afternoon (≈ 15:00); Colombo → Pakistan ≈ 13:35–13:50. **Choose the morning KL flight** so you connect home the same day. Lahore and Karachi each have only about 4 flights a week.

items.title: If the website won't price it
items.text: (1) Try dates 1–2 days earlier or later. (2) Call SriLankan or ask a Pakistani IATA travel agent for **one booking with a Colombo stopover**, and get the price and change rules by email. (3) **Don't** buy separate tickets: FIA's rule needs your return home on the same booking.

items.title: Baggage and the golden rule
items.text: Economy is normally **30 kg + 7 kg cabin**; confirm it on the fare. **Never skip a flight**: the rest of the ticket is cancelled. Changes are by phone, not online.

cols.text: Fares seen on srilankan.com on 6 Nov 2026, for January 2027 dates, round trips with no stopover: Karachi–Bangkok from PKR 1,62,874; Karachi–Colombo 1,70,218; Karachi–KL 1,89,973; Lahore–Bangkok 1,86,670; Lahore–Colombo 1,87,577; Lahore–KL 1,95,173. A stopover ticket usually costs the same or a bit more, and March prices can differ. Get your own quote.
AirAsia Bangkok → Kuala Lumpur

items: Book on airasia.com and **add the 20 kg bag at booking**. Compare Batik Air on the same route.
Check that the flight really runs on your date: Thai AirAsia suspended this route from April to October 2026 during the fuel crisis.
AirAsia leaves from **Don Mueang (DMK)**, not Suvarnabhumi, and lands at **KLIA Terminal 2**. SriLankan uses **KLIA Terminal 1**.
Your 30 kg allowance applies again after KL, so **do your shopping in KL** (the last stop), not Bangkok.

cols.text: Hotels: where to stay (book to match the flight times)

rows: Near the beach road, ≈ 20 min from the airport, because you land at night. USD 15–25.
Near the lake or Temple of the Tooth. USD 15–25.
Fort, Pettah or Kollupitiya. USD 25–35. Ask for late check-out: you leave for the airport at ≈ 9 pm.
**Book from the night of Day 5**, so the room is yours when you land at ≈ 06:15. Pratunam or Ratchathewi: near halal food and quieter than Sukhumvit Soi 3–11 (a nightlife area). USD 25–40.
Bukit Bintang, Chinatown or near Masjid Jamek. RM100–140 + RM10/night tourist tax (+8% service tax if not included). **Prepaid**, ideally still free to cancel.

blocks.text: Before you fly: polio, money, gold rules, insurance, SIM

cols.text: Polio certificate

items: WHO rules for Pakistan (extended from 21 Aug 2026): a polio dose **4 weeks to 12 months before** international travel, with proof.
The dose is **free** at government hospitals, EPI centres and District Health Offices. It is entered into NADRA's system.
Download and print the certificate at **nims.nadra.gov.pk** (about Rs 100 by card, JazzCash or Easypaisa).
Airlines and airport health desks may check it. Carry the printout and a phone copy.

cols.text: Travel insurance

**EFU 'Worldwide excluding USA, Canada, Australia & Japan'**, up to 14 days (this trip is 13): Standard (USD 35k medical) PKR 2,450, or Gold (USD 70k) PKR 3,850. If your dates run past 14 days, the 21-day band is PKR 3,350 / 5,350. Buy it online while in Pakistan (ages up to 66). Check that it covers every country you visit. Pre-existing illnesses are not covered.
SIM cards (buy at the airport, with your passport)

items: **Sri Lanka:** Dialog Tourist SIM, LKR 1,399 for 20 GB, at the Dialog store just after Customs.
**Thailand:** AIS / TrueMove tourist SIM at Suvarnabhumi arrivals (roughly 299–599 baht).
**Malaysia:** U Mobile (≈ RM15 for 7 days) or CelcomDigi (≈ RM25) at the operator's own KLIA counter.
**Keep your Pakistani SIM working for bank OTPs:** switch on international roaming before you leave (receiving SMS is usually free), and switch mobile-data roaming off.

cols.text: Packing and dress

Temples and the Grand Palace need **shoulders and knees covered**; trousers and a shirt are fine, and shoes come off. Bring a light jacket for Kandy evenings and the night flight, an umbrella, walking shoes, a universal plug adapter and a small padlock.
Money: cash, cards, limits

items: **Carry about USD 900 in clean USD 50/100 notes** (USD 1,000 if you pay hotels in cash), bought from a licensed exchange company with your CNIC; keep the receipt.
Keep **USD 650 untouched until Bangkok immigration** and **at least USD 300 until KL immigration**. Pay mostly by card in Sri Lanka and Bangkok, and change money as you go.

**Legal limits leaving Pakistan:** up to USD 5,000 per visit (USD 30,000 a year) in foreign currency. Declare it on the FBR **Pass Track** app or at the Customs desk. Pakistani notes: keep it to Rs 3,000 or less.

**Cards:** switch on international use. Advance tax 236Y is 0.5% if you are on the ATL, 1% if not; banks add ≈ 4% FX fee. Yearly card limit USD 30,000. Take **two cards from different banks**, and always pay in **local currency** (say no to 'pay in PKR').
Use ATMs inside banks or malls (card skimming is reported in Sri Lanka).

cols.title: Gold and jewellery: special rules for you
items: **Do not carry business gold, coins, bars, samples or loose stones** out of Pakistan. State Bank rules do not allow exporting gold.

**Safest: leave your gold jewellery at home.** SBP's general permission lets residents take out only non-gold jewellery worth up to about Rs 2,000; gold articles, or anything more, need SBP permission (Form 'J') before you travel.
Whatever you do wear, **declare it to Pakistan Customs when leaving** (form 'CD') and keep the stamped copy for your return. Sri Lanka and Malaysia also want jewellery declared on arrival.

Buying gold abroad? Check Pakistan Customs' current baggage rules and duty **before** you buy, declare it on return, and don't pay for gold or stock with your personal card (SBP: card use must match personal needs).
**Gem scams:** in Sri Lanka and Bangkok, tuk-tuk drivers take tourists to 'special' gem shops. Don't buy on impulse.

blocks.sub: In 2025 more than 66,000 travellers were stopped ('offloaded') at Pakistani airports, mostly for weak or missing papers. A complete folder solves most of this.

cols.title: Your FIA folder (printed + on phone)
items: Passport + CNIC + old passports
Thai e-Visa, Malaysia eVISA, Sri Lanka ETA (printed)
**SriLankan e-ticket (one booking, shows your return home)** + AirAsia ticket
Hotel bookings for **every** night + this itinerary
Travel insurance certificate
NIMS polio certificate
Personal + business bank statements (stamped) and maintenance certificates
NTN / ATL printout, chamber or sarafa association certificate, business letterhead letter, business card
Currency declaration (Pass Track) + exchange receipt
**Arrive 4 hours early.** Since October 2026 there are extra document checks before immigration.

**Same-airline rule:** FIA asks visit-visa travellers to Bangkok and Malaysia for a return ticket on the same airline/booking (directive of Oct 2024; no withdrawal found as of Nov 2026). Your single SriLankan booking meets it.
**No Protector stamp** is needed for tourists. Carry nothing that looks like job-hunting (no CVs, no job offers).
Answer simply and consistently: **'Tourism, 13 days: Sri Lanka, Thailand, Malaysia. I own a gold business in [city]. I return on [date].'**
**There is no paid 'FIA clearance'.** A fake WhatsApp service was exposed in October 2026; ignore anyone offering 'setting'. The FIA e-immigration app had not launched in November 2026.

cols.title: If you are offloaded
items: **Before the flight leaves**, call SriLankan (+94 11 777 1979) or go to its check-in desk and ask to move your booking to a new date (change fee). If you simply don't fly, the whole multi-city ticket is cancelled as a no-show.
Politely ask FIA for the **written reason / a copy of the offloading proforma**. The Lahore High Court (May 2026) said reasons must be recorded and given.
Apply for review to the airport's Incharge Immigration / Deputy Director **within 7 days** (decision within 3 days), then the FIA Zonal Grievance Committee (decision within 10 days).
Complaints: **FIA helpline 1991**. Keep your boarding pass and tickets.

blocks.sub: Example dates: Tue 23 March → Sun 4 April 2027, built around SriLankan's 2026 flight times. Use your own dates and times; keep the number of nights.

items.place: 🇵🇰 → 🇱🇰 Fly to Colombo, sleep in Negombo
items.plan: Evening SriLankan flight (≈ 4 h), landing ≈ 21:30–22:30. Change about USD 100 into rupees at a bank counter in the arrival hall, and buy a Dialog SIM after Customs. PickMe/Uber to your Negombo hotel (≈ 20 min, ≈ LKR 2,000–3,000).

Morning: private car to Kandy (≈ 3–3.5 h, about LKR 16,000–17,000 / USD 50; book via your hotel, or use Uber/PickMe). Afternoon: **Temple of the Tooth** (≈ LKR 1,500–2,000; light, modest clothes) and a walk round Kandy Lake. Dinner at the **Kandyan Muslim Hotel** (since 1907).

Leave at 6:00 by car with driver; agree an all-in price (about LKR 18,000–25,000) and check he has fuel (Sri Lanka still had fuel quotas in 2026). Climb **Sigiriya Lion Rock** at opening (show your original passport for the SAARC price, ≈ USD 20 instead of 35). Then the **Dambulla cave temple** (≈ LKR 3,000). Back by evening.

Early: **Peradeniya Botanic Gardens** (≈ LKR 3,540; on the Colombo road). Jumu'ah in Kandy, then the **air-conditioned intercity bus** to Colombo at about 2 pm (≈ 3.5–4 h, ≈ LKR 740). It is Good Friday, a public holiday, so buses are busy; a car (≈ USD 50) is the easy option. As of Nov 2026 trains from Colombo stop at Peradeniya, not Kandy (bridge repairs). Evening: **Galle Face Green**. **Fill the Thai TDAC tonight or tomorrow.**

**Jami Ul-Alfar (Red) Mosque** and **Pettah market**. Sea Street, Colombo's jewellers' street, is next door: interesting for a gold trader, but don't buy on impulse. Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square. Late check-out or leave your bag at reception. About 9 pm, PickMe/Uber to the airport (≈ 45–60 min), with the printed Thai e-Visa ready for check-in.
items.cost: Night: on the ≈ 01:05 flight to Bangkok

items.plan: At immigration show the printed e-Visa, TDAC QR, hotel booking and onward ticket, and your 20,000 baht if asked. Thai SIM at arrivals. Airport Rail Link into the city (≈ 45 baht; get off at Ratchaprarop or Phaya Thai). Your room is ready (booked from last night): sleep. Late afternoon: **Chatuchak weekend market** (Sundays) or a halal dinner.

**Grand Palace + Wat Phra Kaew** at 8:30 (500 baht; strict dress code; ticket also covers a Khon show within 7 days). Walk to **Wat Pho** (300 baht). Cross-river ferry to **Wat Arun** (200 baht) for sunset. Ignore anyone saying 'the palace is closed today', a classic scam.

Train from Krung Thep Aphiwat (≈ 1 h) or Hua Lamphong (≈ 2 h, ≈ 20 baht). Temple pass ≈ 300 baht (or 80 per temple). Tuk-tuk or bicycle between the ruins; back by evening. **Fill the Malaysia MDAC (today, tomorrow or Thursday).**
**Chinatown (Yaowarat)**: Bangkok's famous gold-shop street. **Haroon Mosque** (Bang Rak). Chao Phraya Express boat. MBK/Pratunam markets, but keep shopping light for the 20 kg AirAsia bag.

Grab to **Don Mueang** (≈ 400 baht), 2–3 h before the flight. AirAsia to KLIA2 (≈ 2 h). Show your papers at immigration; use an ATM or money changer and buy a SIM. Airport bus to KL Sentral (≈ RM15), then LRT or Grab to the hotel. Evening: **KLCC Park** and the lit Petronas Towers.
**Jumu'ah at Masjid Negara** (National Mosque). Next door, the **Islamic Arts Museum** (RM20, open 9:30–18:00). Merdeka Square, Masjid Jamek, Central Market.

Morning: **Batu Caves** by KTM train (free; dress modestly). Afternoon: **Putrajaya** by KLIA Transit (RM16.60 each way): Putra Mosque, Iron Mosque, the lake. Evening: shopping (your 30 kg allowance is back), pack, early night. Optional: Petronas Skybridge (RM80–98, book a time slot).

For the morning KL → Colombo flight, leave the hotel at ≈ 5 am: KLIA Ekspres (first trains from about 5 am; RM58.50 online) or Grab to **KLIA Terminal 1**. At check-in ask for your bag to be **checked through** to Lahore/Karachi. In Colombo follow the **Transfers** signs (not Arrivals) to your ≈ 13:35–13:50 flight home. Declare any jewellery or purchases to Pakistan Customs.

blocks.title: If your KL → Colombo flight is the afternoon one
blocks.text: It lands after the day's flight to Pakistan has left, so you stay one night in Colombo and fly home on Day 14. Your double-entry ETA lets you leave the airport (a Negombo hotel ≈ USD 20–25, from the cushion), or ask SriLankan when booking whether its free transit hotel applies (connections of 8–24 hours on one booking).

Pakistan missions in Colombo, Bangkok, KL (from mofa.gov.pk)

cols.title: Prayer, food and safety
items: **Halal logos:** HAC (Sri Lanka), CICOT (Thailand), JAKIM (Malaysia).
Use **PickMe/Uber** (Sri Lanka) and **Grab** (Thailand, Malaysia) instead of street taxis. Agree tuk-tuk fares first.
Avoid Thailand's far south and the Thai–Cambodian border area (travel warnings). This plan doesn't go there.

blocks.text: If something goes wrong: costs, Plan B and Plan C

head: What happens
What you lose (approx.)
What to do
rows: Fee 13,000 + trip to pay it (1,500–6,000) + AirAsia ≈ 26,600 (non-refundable) + SriLankan change fee: **≈ PKR 40,000–70,000**.
Switch to Plan B, but shorten it to ≈ 10 nights (e.g. skip Penang) to stay within 5 lakh.
Fee ≈ 9,000 + AirAsia ≈ 26,600 + KL hotel (unless free to cancel) + SriLankan change fee.
Stay those 3 nights in Bangkok (the Thai visa allows 60 days). Ask SriLankan to start your return from Bangkok. Never just skip the KL → Colombo flight.
Change fee; hotels on free cancellation are refundable.
Call SriLankan **before the flight leaves** to move the dates (section 10).
A ticket home from Bangkok airport (the Thai visa is used).
Avoid it: paid hotel, return ticket, cash ≥ USD 300, clear answers (section 6).
Usually nothing if you rebook on the same booking.
Phone SriLankan to rebook via Colombo. **Don't accept a reroute through Dubai, Doha, Muscat or Bahrain** while the 2026 Iran war continues (airport strikes, sudden airspace closures).

cols.text: Plan B: Sri Lanka + Malaysia (13 nights, ≈ PKR 4.5–4.6 lakh)

Use this if the 3-country ticket costs more than PKR 1.8 lakh (common from Lahore). It is also the most relaxed version, and needs no Thai visa. Everything except the ticket ≈ PKR 2.6 lakh; ticket ≈ 1.95 lakh (Karachi) to 2.05 lakh (Lahore).

items.title: Ticket
items.text: SriLankan: Lahore/Karachi → Colombo (stopover) → Kuala Lumpur, and KL → Colombo → home, on one booking. If you are switching from the 3-country ticket after a Thai refusal, ask SriLankan to change Colombo → Bangkok into Colombo → KL, keeping your flight home (change fee + any fare difference).

items.title: Sri Lanka 6 nights
items.text: Negombo 1, Kandy 2 (with the Sigiriya/Dambulla day), Colombo 2, plus 1 night in Galle or back in Negombo.

items.title: Malaysia 7 nights
items.text: KL 4 (one more night than the main plan) + **Penang 3**: George Town heritage streets, Kapitan Keling Mosque, Penang Hill, nasi kandar (Penang's famous halal food). ETS train KL ↔ Butterworth, about 4 hours.

items.title: Visa
items.text: Sri Lanka free + Malaysia RM126. Apply for the eVISA only once the ticket is final, uploading the new ticket and paid KL and Penang bookings. On the MDAC, the last port is Colombo. Stay inside Malaysia: leaving and coming back needs a new eVISA.

cols.text: Plan C: Sri Lanka + Maldives (free visas)
Both visas cost nothing: the Maldives gives a free 30-day visa on arrival to almost every nationality, including Pakistan.

items: One SriLankan booking: Pakistan → Colombo (stopover) → Malé → Colombo → Pakistan.

Maldives rules: a **prepaid** booking at a registered guesthouse, a return ticket, enough money (carry at least USD 100 + 50 a day), and the free **IMUGA** declaration within 96 hours before landing (imuga.immigration.gov.mv). Carry your polio certificate.

Stay on a local island like **Maafushi**. Guesthouses cost ≈ USD 50–80 a night **after** taxes (≈ 17% TGST + 10% service charge + ≈ USD 6 green tax per night are added to base prices). All food is halal; dress modestly; no public ferries on Fridays.

About **PKR 4.5–5 lakh** from Karachi for ~6 nights in Sri Lanka + 3–4 in the Maldives; Lahore costs more. If you come here after visa refusals, add what is already lost, and cut the Maldives to 2–3 nights or postpone.

cols.title: Thinking ahead: building travel history
cols.text: Clean trips with easy visas (Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Thailand) help later applications. After 3–5 trips over 1–2 years, with filed tax returns and a steady bank history, a **Schengen, UK or US** visa becomes much more realistic, and a valid one also unlocks the Turkey e-Visa and Georgia's e-visa. Never overstay, keep every boarding pass, and declare any past refusal honestly.
